title: Part 7: Đọc hiểu (Reading Comprehension)
description: Đọc đoạn văn và trả lời câu hỏi. Đoạn đơn (Part 7a) và đoạn kép (Part 7b). 54 câu hỏi.

items.passage:
MEMO

To: All Staff
From: Sarah Chen, HR Director
Date: March 15
Subject: Annual Health Check-Up

We are pleased to announce that the company's annual health check-up program will take place on April 10-12 at the City Medical Center, located at 450 Health Avenue.

Employees should schedule their appointment by calling 555-0123 or visiting our intranet page. Each session takes approximately 2 hours, and employees may attend during work hours without using vacation time.

Please note that fasting is required for 8 hours before blood tests. Water is permitted.

For questions, contact the HR department at ext. 4567.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the memo?
options: To inform about a health check-up program
questions.explanation: Mục đích thông báo về chương trình khám sức khỏe định kỳ (annual health check-up program).

questions.q: Where will the health check-up take place?
questions.explanation: Địa điểm là City Medical Center, located at 450 Health Avenue.

questions.q: What must employees do before blood tests?
questions.explanation: "fasting is required for 8 hours before blood tests" = nhịn ăn 8 tiếng.

questions.q: How can employees schedule their appointment?
questions.explanation: "calling 555-0123 or visiting our intranet page" = qua điện thoại hoặc intranet.
